name: Togakushi Haruka
source:
Reserved and timid but she is in fact a big closet pervert. She voluntarily agreed to help Yukina in the compensated dating scam after being helped by her in a molester incident.

[spoiler]Due to her massive pervert tendency she always has delusions about many extreme situations and she uses her job as adult novel writer to express them through texts. She also unconsciously expects to meet someone evil like protagonist who can fulfill her wild fantasies.[/spoiler]
